whatThisIs: Five public residential leases that replace the unavailable sources L02, L04, L05, L06 and L09 (decision 1). Holdout only: no product, judge or model run on them before their adjudicated labels are frozen, and no prompt or completeness work may read them. Kept apart from evals/lease-corpus/manifest.json so `npm run eval:leases` can never pick them up. Sources and text are local only (evals/holdout/.gitignore).
